T1.name: Rivière Classique Necklace, Silver
T1.lock: A CLASSIC TENNIS NECKLACE: ONE continuous unbroken line of identical small ROUND brilliant-cut clear stones, each in its own four-claw cup, linked edge to edge all the way round with no chain, no gaps, no pendant, no centre station and no buckle; a small box clasp at the back.
T1.neg: Every stone is the same size and round, never graduated, never baguette or square; one single row only, never two rows; every stone is icy clear white with rainbow sparkle, never tinted; nothing hangs from it.
T1.scale: Each round stone is 3mm, the size of a mustard seed, so the whole line is only as thick as a phone charging cable; about 130 stones make the 40cm necklace. Next to the cube it reads as a fine thread of light, never chunky.
T1.wscale: The line is only 3mm wide, a fine thread of light lying on the skin at the base of the neck, just above the collarbones; each stone is the size of a mustard seed.
T1.place: draped across the cube in one long loose curve: it lies over the top face, its line runs over the cube's front edge and falls down the front face, the small box clasp resting on top; clearly a long necklace, far longer than the cube is wide, never coiled into a small closed circle like a bracelet
T1.macro: a short curved run of the small round clear stones in their four-claw cups
